name: reflexion_lesson_memory
hypothesis: Storing LLM-distilled correction rules (Reflexion-style) instead of raw examples will achieve higher val accuracy than 26% by capturing generalizable error patterns with explicit guidance, without the noise of irrelevant raw examples.

name: chinese_bigram_confusion_memory
hypothesis: Replacing the ASCII-only tokenizer with Chinese character bigrams will give the confusion-disambiguation selection algorithm meaningful Jaccard scores (vs. near-zero for all pairs), enabling it to retrieve genuinely similar examples and improving val accuracy above 26%.

name: label_vocab_memory
hypothesis: Maintaining a registry of all canonical label strings seen in training and injecting them as a 'Valid Labels' section at the top of the prompt will reduce label format errors (suffix hallucination, truncation, wrong specificity) and increase val accuracy above 38%.

name: contrastive_error_memory
hypothesis: Storing (input_tokens, wrong_prediction, correct_label) contrastive pairs and presenting the top input-similar pairs in a dedicated 'Common Mistakes' section before positive examples will reduce systematic confusion errors and increase val accuracy above 38%.
